notes:
- Apps closes on an outside primary click while passing the click through. Choosing an app starts closing the menu as it brings the app forward. An app that quits independently only updates the running row. Apps is included in Full.
- The taskbar adjusts windows that cover it using a single 100 ms scan. The scan also handles windows that settle lower than the top of the working area. Finder windows are tracked alongside other open windows.
- Shift–Command now observes its shortcut through a passive event tap. A confirmed Accessibility loss stops new Accessibility operations and triggers DeskMote's shutdown.
- Show Battery Runtime Estimates uses macOS power-history records and shows the time of the estimate. Refresh rereads the system records on demand.
- Removed the air quality widget, the development product, built-in diagnostic logging, and the development automation interface.

Apple silicon app for macOS 27 or later. The installable ZIP is ad hoc signed.
